# nobus_lbaas_failover (Resource)

Triggers a one-shot LBaaS load-balancer failover. Change trigger to run it again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nobus_lbaas_failover" "example" {
  load_balancer_id = nobus_lbaas_load_balancer.example.id
  trigger          = "maintenance-2026-10-12"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String)
- `trigger` (String)

### Optional

- `availability_zone` (String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
